author: MALCOMB GRAVES
text: Spud has put in several septic systems for me over the years and has done some land clearing and grade jobs. He has always been honest and extremely easy to deal. I would recommend him to anyone that asks.

author: Caleb Beaver
text: Septic done 2 days after estimate! Fast, dependable, professional service with photos and explanations of every step. Would recommend this service to anyone.

author: Nick New
text: Awesome job replacing my field lines and septic tank. Very fast work and got it knocked out in a short period of time 100% recommended. Thanks for the job. Next job for him he’s going to build me a pad for a pole barn. Looking forward to it as well.

author: Ricky Shaw
text: WOW, Needed a septic system in a hurry with really only a 2 day notice.  Spud Mr Brasher excepted the job and knocked it out for us.  I run a business finding people that want to work and want to make there customers happy is hard to find these days not only do I recommend Spud and his team we will be using him for other projects coming up

author: Aaron Sellers
text: Was there on time and septic system installed and covered before days end.   It was a great couple of guys to work with.
